episode.title: Roman Concrete: Fact Or Ancient Propaganda?

synopsis: Modern science in 2023 confirmed that Roman concrete possesses a self-healing capability, thanks to its unique composition.
narration: Roman concrete's legendary durability isn't just myth. In 2023, MIT confirmed its secret: lime clasts. These tiny fragments react with water, self-healing cracks over time. An ancient engineering marvel, still baffling us today.

shots.prompt: Roman engineers intently mixing materials and pouring concrete into massive wooden forms at a construction site for a grand public building. Dust motes dance in the sunlight, showing the scale and physical effort of the work.

An extreme, macro close-up of a section of Roman concrete. Fine, hairline cracks are visible, with tiny, bright white lime clasts within them. A subtle, almost imperceptible visual of the cracks seemingly closing over time, implying the self-healing process.

music: A rhythmic, industrial-percussive track, hinting at intricate ancient construction and modern scientific discovery. It has a slightly mysterious, intelligent feel, building with a sense of revelation and continuing with a steady, complex groove.
